capabilities: reveal the left sidebar when the mouse touches the left window edge
collapse the sidebar on a rightward swipe past its edge
toggle the sidebar manually via hotkey or button
hide and show the ribbon together with the sidebar
expose tunable parameters such as edge zone and trigger width
extras: Desktop only (isDesktopOnly: true); installable manually or via BRAT. Settings include a master switch, unified open/close, and ribbon syncing.
intentEvidence: An ARC-browser-style sidebar for Obsidian: sweep the mouse to the left edge of the window and the sidebar slides out
problem: Obsidian's left sidebar must be opened manually or hovered over the ribbon; there is no edge-of-window mouse gesture to reveal it.

relations.evidence: An ARC-browser-style sidebar for Obsidian: sweep the mouse to the left edge of the window and the sidebar slides out

summary: UI tweak that slides the left sidebar out when the mouse touches the window's left edge and slides it back on a rightward swipe, ARC-browser style.
